users.title: Users
users.description: Who can sign in, which roles they hold and which employee they are.
users.label: Users
users.noResultsBody: Check the spelling, or clear the filters to see everyone.
users.emptyBody: Add the people who should sign in, and give each one a role.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.body: They are signed out everywhere at once and can't sign in until reactivated. Their history stays.
deactivate.done: {name} was deactivated and signed out everywhere.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.body: They can sign in again with their current password, with the roles they hold.

users.lastAdmin: The last System admin can't be deactivated.
users.lockedTitle: Too many wrong passwords: sign-in is locked until {time}.

unlock.title: Unlock sign-in for {name}?
unlock.body: Their wrong passwords are forgotten and they can sign in right away.

userForm.addDescription: New users get a temporary password and choose their own when they first sign in.
userForm.editDescription: Edit the account, its roles and the linked employee.
userForm.viewDescription: The account, its roles and the linked employee.
userForm.name: Full name
userForm.rolesHint: Pick one or more. The user gets every permission of every role.
userForm.noRoles: No role picked: this user can sign in but sees nothing yet.
userForm.lockedAdmin: {name} is the only System admin. Give the role to someone else first.
userForm.employeeHint: Scopes like “Their stage” and “Their team” use this employee.
userForm.employeeFieldHint: Search by name or employee code.
userForm.passwordHint: Forgot it? Give a temporary password. They are signed out everywhere and must choose a new one at sign-in.
userForm.mustChangeBody: {name} will be asked for a new password at their next sign-in.
userForm.requiredMissing: Fill in the name and email
userForm.created: {name} was added. Give them the temporary password.
userForm.lockedBody: Too many wrong passwords. Sign-in is locked until {time}, unless you unlock it.

tempPassword.label: Temporary password
tempPassword.shownOnce: Shown only once. {name} must choose their own password the first time they sign in.
tempPassword.shownOnceNoName: Shown only once. They must choose their own password the first time they sign in.
tempPassword.dialogBody: Give them this password. They are signed out everywhere now and must choose their own when they sign in.
tempPassword.doneBody: {name} was signed out everywhere and must choose a new password at sign-in.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: A role is a set of permissions. A user can hold several roles and gets all of their permissions.
roles.label: Roles
roles.note: Starting roles and custom roles can be edited, and deleted once nobody holds them. System admin always holds every permission and can't be deleted.

delete.title: Delete the role “{name}”?
delete.body: Nobody holds it. Deleting it can't be undone; the activity log keeps what it granted.
delete.startingRole: It's a starting role: future updates add new permissions to starting roles automatically. A role you make to replace it won't get them.
delete.blockedBody: Take the role away from them in Users first.

roles.emptyBody: Add a custom role to group the permissions some users need.

roleForm.addDescription: Name the role, then switch on what its holders may see and do.
roleForm.description: What a holder of this role can see and do. Scopes limit some permissions to their own stage or team.
roleForm.name: Name
roleForm.permissionsHint: Turn a permission on, then choose whose records it covers.
roleForm.noHolders: Nobody holds this role yet. Give it to someone on their user page.

scopes.own_stage: Employees of the stage of the user's linked employee.
scopes.own_team: Employees whose direct manager is the user's linked employee.
scopes.self: Only the user's own linked employee.

roleForm.systemAdminBody: The System admin always has every permission, including ones added later. It can't be edited or deleted, and the last System admin can't lose the role.
roleForm.saved: Role saved. Its holders get the change on their next click.

account.title: My account
account.description: Your sign-in details. Only you can change your password.
account.name: Full name
account.askAdmin: Ask a System admin to change your name or email.
account.noRoles: No roles yet. Ask a System admin.
account.changePasswordHint: Choose a password you don't use anywhere else.
account.notificationsDescription: Choose what you are told about.

noAccess.body: Ask a System admin if you need it.
noAccess.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted. Go back to the list.
